content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Peoria

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP credential requires a secondary degree plus documented project-management experience, or a high school diploma with additional years of hands-on PM work. Review PMI's specific education and experience thresholds, then gather proof of your project leadership background before you apply.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. This structured classroom experience covers the PMBOK Guide framework, real-world applications, and exam strategy—delivered on a schedule that fits working professionals in Peoria's insurance, healthcare, manufacturing, and government sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After training, create your PMI account and submit your formal credential application, including your education credentials and documented project-management experience. Pay the PMI examination fee to activate your eligibility window and secure your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor review sessions—to reinforce PMBOK knowledge and test-taking strategy. Schedule your proctored exam and complete it within your PMI eligibility window.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP is valid for three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through approved training, volunteer work, or community involvement to renew. Plan your PDU strategy early so you meet the renewal deadline without interruption to your credential status.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
